title: Social Media & Brand Manager
description:
SOCIAL MEDIA & BRAND MANAGER

Company: PickleMonk Media

Location: Chennai

Experience: 2–3 Years

Salary: ₹3–3.6 LPA

Department: Brand & Digital Marketing

Employment Type: Full-time

Work Mode: On-site; PickleMonk Media - Corporate Office, Virugambakkam, Chennai

About PickleMonk Media

PickleMonk Media is a Brand Communication Solution Provider combining creative strategy, advertising, content production and digital marketing.

We work with brands across industries to build meaningful communication, create engaging campaigns and drive business growth.

We are looking for a proactive, creative and strategically minded Social Media & Brand Manager who can take ownership of brand communication, digital presence and social media marketing for our clients.

Role Overview

The Social Media & Brand Manager will be responsible for managing multiple client brands, developing social media strategies, planning content, executing digital campaigns and maintaining consistent brand communication across platforms.

This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, creative understanding, content planning, digital marketing knowledge and execution capabilities.

You should understand not just what to post, but why a brand should post it, who it should reach and what business objective it should achieve.

Key Responsibilities1. Brand Management & Strategy

* Understand client businesses, target audiences, products and market positioning.
* Develop brand communication strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Maintain brand consistency across digital platforms.
* Identify brand opportunities, communication gaps and market trends.
* Develop campaign concepts and communication plans.
* Work closely with the Creative Director to translate brand strategy into creative campaigns.
* Monitor brand perception, audience engagement and digital presence.

2. Social Media Management

* Manage social media accounts across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.
* Develop monthly and weekly content calendars.
* Plan content themes, campaigns, reels, carousels, stories and static creatives.
* Write or coordinate creative captions, headlines and post descriptions.
* Ensure timely publishing and consistent content execution.
* Monitor comments, messages and audience interactions.
* Identify relevant trends and opportunities for brand participation.
* Track content performance and optimise the content strategy.

3. Digital Marketing & Campaign Management

* Plan and execute social media marketing campaigns.
* Manage Meta Ads campaigns and coordinate with performance marketing resources.
* Understand audience targeting, campaign objectives, budgets and lead generation.
* Monitor campaign performance and recommend improvements.
* Drive relevant traffic, enquiries, engagement and conversions.
* Coordinate with the performance marketing team for campaign optimisation.

4. Content Strategy & Creative Coordination

* Develop content ideas based on brand objectives and audience insights.
* Create detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors and production teams.
* Coordinate with the creative and production teams to execute campaigns.
* Review creatives and videos before publishing.
* Ensure content meets brand guidelines and communication objectives.
* Identify opportunities for innovative, engaging and shareable content.

5. Analytics & Reporting

* Track social media performance and campaign metrics.
* Prepare monthly brand performance reports.
* Monitor reach, impressions, engagement, followers, leads and conversions.
* Analyse content performance and identify what works and what doesn't.
* Provide actionable recommendations based on data.
* Maintain individual brand performance trackers.

6. Client Coordination & Account Management

* Understand client requirements and campaign expectations.
* Participate in client meetings and strategy discussions.
* Coordinate approvals, feedback and content schedules.
* Ensure deliverables are completed within agreed timelines.
* Maintain clear communication with clients.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve client accounts.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–5 years of experience in social media marketing, brand management or digital marketing.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.
* Knowledge of Meta Business Suite and Meta Ads Manager.
* Excellent content planning and creative briefing skills.
* Good copywriting and communication abilities.
* Understanding of branding, positioning and marketing fundamentals.
* Ability to analyse social media insights and campaign reports.
* Strong organisational and project management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple brands simultaneously.
* Good presentation and client communication skills.

What We Are Looking For

* Someone who thinks like a marketer, not just a social media publisher.
* Someone who understands the difference between content and communication.
* Someone who can bring ideas to the table rather than wait for instructions.
* Someone who understands both creative quality and business objectives.
* Someone who takes ownership of deadlines and deliverables.
* Someone who keeps up with digital trends without blindly following them.
* Someone who can balance creativity, strategy and execution.

Performance Expectations (KPIs)

* Timely execution of monthly content calendars.
* Quality and consistency of brand communication.
* Social media growth and audience engagement.
* Campaign performance and lead generation.
* Creative planning and execution efficiency.
* Client satisfaction and account retention.
* Accuracy and consistency of monthly reporting.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume and portfolio at:

Email: creative@picklemonkmedia.com

title: VP - CFO Business Partnering
description:

**To Be Successful In This Role, You Should Have**

* PBWM business knowledge: Strong understanding of the Private Banking and Wealth Management landscape in India and globally, including key products, client propositions and industry dynamics.
* Business partnering: Proven experience partnering with business and Front Office stakeholders, providing effective challenge and translating business priorities into financial insights and actions.
* Commercial and financial acumen: Strong understanding of financial statements, business performance drivers and key performance indicators, with the ability to interpret financial information and identify risks, opportunities and performance trends.
* Expertise in MI Reporting, financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis.
* Stakeholder management & Leadership.
* Decision making and problem solving.
* Analytical reasoning and Attention to detail.

* Change and project management.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Chennai.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To provide financial expertise and support to specific business units or departments within the organisation, and act as a liaison between the finance function and various business units, helping to bridge the gap between financial data and business decisions.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of business unit financial strategies, plans and budgets, using insights to evaluate the financial implications of strategic initiatives and recommend appropriate actions.
* Development of financial models to forecast future performance, assess investment opportunities, and evaluate financial risks for business units, and to analyse the impact of business decisions on financial performance and provision of recommendations. .
* Cross functional collaboration to provide financial insights and guidance to business unit stakeholders.
* Identification of opportunities and implementation of financial process improvements that streamline financial operations.
* Support to business units in identification, assessment, and mitigation of financial risks, including provision of training and guidance to business units on financial risk management and compliance practices.
* Analysis and presentation of financial data to provide insights into business performance, identify trends, and support decision-making.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Billing Transformation – Product (ORMB) - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Functional Job Title : Billing Transformation – Product (ORMB) -Assistant Vice President**
**Reports to : BTP VP**
**Department/ Division : Global Delivery, Chennai**
**Job Description: AVP – Product Management**
**Why this role is important to us.**
Global Billing Operations (“GBO”) is responsible for all of State Street’s client billing processes across the globe. The remit spans across Asset Servicing, Alpha, Global Markets, Global Advisors and the Digital division. GBO is undergoing a multi-year transformation spanning people and operating models, processes and controls, data automation and technology.
  
  
State Street has established a Global Billing Function under Global Finance Center under Controllership, which is responsible for Billing Transformation, Client billing set up and invoicing across all business lines and geographies globally at State Street. Organizationally, it combines all groups performing these activities and also includes centers residing in State Street Shared Service locations in India, Poland and China.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
State Street has committed to significantly automating and streamlining the technology and data associated to its varied billing processes. As part of this commitment, there is a dedicated Billing Transformation organization responsible for developing and implementing the appropriate strategy to migrate from legacy, manual processes to a highly automated environment with more robust controls. A significant component of the Transformation team is located in Global Delivery and is responsible for several key areas of implementing the transformation efforts.
  
  
AVP 2 (ORMB Product Management) – GD will be supporting Billing Transformation Product Owner(s), as the team implements billing transformation strategy across Client Set Up Application, Data Hub, and ORMB billing application. The person will be partnering with onshore product owner(s), developing business requirements (FSDs, BRDs and etc.), track, report progress, targets and outcomes linked to target state of product and applications. This role will be responsible for ensuring all product releases, toll gates within agreed timelines, automation, user acceptance testing of applications, system build out validation in line with the strategy and prioritization defined by the Head of Billing Transformation to achieve the goals of migration to the single, Oracle based billing platform (ORMB).
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Actively participate/contribute to Product workshops along with Product owner, Stakeholders and IT partners.
* Create user stories/Business requirements as needed and work with IT partners to scope those requirements for the future product releases and to document/track the backlog for future releases.
* Work with the product end user teams to identify pain points or tasks that can be automated to reduce the client onboarding/setup duration. Triage with the product owner to add the requirements to the backlog and track them to closure.
* Working knowledge of JIRA / Confluence and Agile / Waterfall methodologies is a must.
* Work across the project/BAU teams of business and technology to analyze and explain any issues/solutions pertaining to the billing product.
* Work along with the Business UAT Team in testing new product features or fixes, as part of the release schedule/cycle.
* Develop/review SOP, Workarounds, checklists to document all the features of the billing product(s)
* The product specialist will work in a fast-paced complex engagement model on a day-to-day basis.
* Collaborate closely with the In-Market Product owner(s) and Platform management team to understand expectations and deliverable timelines and ensure that deliverables of the team are load balanced as compared to team staffing.
* Develop the team to adopt "owner's mind set", work independently, and effectively manage timelines
* Manage/collaborate with resources to assist with ad-hoc projects and new activities to support the GBO controller group and program
* Evolve process for Billing Transformation, performing managerial reasonableness reviews and discussing reporting & analytics deliverables prepared by the team.
* Provide support to key stakeholders of the team to present analytical results, triage findings and identify solutions
* First point of escalation within the local reporting line for dealing with issues (people/process/technology) and ensuring that compliance requirements are adhered to (e.g. company policies surrounding standard of conduct, information security, employment regulations)
* Coaches Strong collaboration with the team and works with onshore leadership to establish the team member goals and gather feedback for performance appraisals.
* Ensure completion of deliverables within the committed timeframe including assistance with development of deliverable plans.
* Promote risk excellence culture and looking at opportunities for continuous improvement.

**What We Value**

* Attention to detail, ownership and accountability
* Ability to navigate and partner with various stakeholders
* Ability to lead teams and manage cross functional domain teams
* Ability to communicate and above-par presentation skills
* Positive attitude, organized, self-starter, with a history of contributing to a successful, diverse team
* Demonstrated experience of multi-tasking and effective time management with attention to detail in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to influence across siloes and work with broader teams and a collaborative attitude

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in IT/Product Management with an experience minimum of 12 to 15 years working with in Financial/Global Services Organization /Investment banking related IT Industry
* Worked as a product owner, Product specialist or product design owner in a global multi-faceted function.
* Well versed with billing processes in corporate environment
* Exposure to Financial services industry
* Experience within global projects/stakeholders and global organizations
* Complex operational setting involving analysis of financial data
* Engaged in business or migration/conversion processes
* Experience of Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB) application is a must have
* Direct support to business or product line management / executives

**Additional Requirements**

* Experience in setting up managing, people, managing and tracking deliverables, setting up reporting cadence ability to summarize – and provide status to key stakeholders
* Understanding of State Street – functional structure- and experience in GD, Operations (would be an added advantage)

**Additional Locations**
**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: In-house Videographer and Editor
description:
**In-House Videographer and Editor**

**Biotastic Health Systems | Chennai | In-office | Full-time**

**Solo role | Works directly with the Founder | Chennai**

Some jobs give you a desk and a task list. This one puts you right next to the Founder, with a camera in your hand and a front-row seat to how a company gets built.

Biotastic is a wellness technology company in Chennai. We make ice baths, infrared saunas and red light therapy panels for gyms, hotels, clinics and homes across India. Our products look incredible on camera, our customers have powerful stories, and we are growing fast.

At the centre of it all is our Founder, an innovator in every sense. On any given day he is designing a new product, shaping how the company is structured, meeting high net worth clients, or thinking through the next big move for the brand. As our videographer, you will be with him for most of your day, filming, planning and building alongside him. You will see up close how ideas turn into products, how deals come together and how a business is run from the inside. Very few people get this kind of exposure this early, and we are confident you will learn more here in a year than most roles teach in five.

This is a solo role and a high-ownership seat. You will be the one person running all of Biotastic’s video content, from the first idea to the final post, and you will be expected to figure things out on your own. It takes a certain kind of person to thrive here. Most people find it too much. The ones who are hungry, who hustle and who know they are meant for something bigger find it is exactly where they belong.

**The Two Kinds Of Content You Will Make**

**Founder-led content:**
The Founder on camera, talking about recovery, the wellness industry, product design and what it really takes to build a brand.

**Brand content:**
Our products in action, the installations, and the people who use them every day.

**What Your Days Will Look Like**

* Shadowing the Founder through product design sessions, strategy discussions and client meetings, capturing the moments worth sharing
* Brainstorming ideas with him and turning them into sharp, punchy scripts
* Setting up cameras, lights and backdrops, and shooting in the office or on site at hotels, gyms and clinics
* Editing footage into reels and long-form videos that grab attention in the first second and hold it till the end
* Posting on LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram, tracking what works and owning the results
* Bringing fresh ideas to the table every week, before anyone asks
* Jumping on last-minute shoots and still delivering on time
* Keeping the footage library organised so nothing good ever gets lost

**This Role Is For You If You**

* Want full ownership of your work and the freedom that comes with it
* Are comfortable working solo and being the go-to person for everything video
* Learn fast and love being around people who build things
* Are strong in at least one editing tool: Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci or CapCut
* Can handle a camera and basic lighting on your own (bigger setups we will work out together)
* Can feel when a cut is dragging and fix it before anyone notices
* Know how LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram each work, or pick it up quickly
* Can turn a rough idea into a clear, tight script
* Stay sharp on busy days and bring your best energy to every shoot
* Take feedback in your stride and come back with something better

**Bonus Points For**

* Motion graphics or basic After Effects
* Colour grading
* Designing thumbnails and stills
* Experience with fitness, wellness, sport or hospitality content

**What You Get**

* A front-row seat next to the Founder, learning product design, business building and how big decisions get made
* Exposure to high-value clients, real installations and the inner workings of a fast-growing company
* Every piece of gear you need: cameras, lenses, lights, props and a space to shoot in
* Real products, real customers and real locations, so there is always something great to film
* Work that goes live fast, so you see your impact almost immediately
* A real path to growth. Our content function is just getting started, and the right person will grow into leading it
* Pay based on your portfolio and the quality of your work

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Category Manager**
who can take complete ownership of a destination or travel category and build it like an independent business.

You will be responsible for identifying market opportunities, creating differentiated products, building the right supplier ecosystem, improving pricing and margins, enabling sales, working with marketing, and driving customer satisfaction.

**“This destination is my business. Revenue, margins, product quality, suppliers, conversion, customer experience, and growth are all my responsibility.”**

**Category Strategy**

* Build the growth strategy for an assigned destination or travel category.
* Identify demand opportunities based on seasonality, customer trends, visa changes, airline connectivity, search demand, and competitor activity.
* Define the right customer segments, product mix, pricing strategy, and growth priorities.
* Create quarterly and annual plans for revenue, margins, and market share.

**Product Development**

* Build differentiated itineraries and travel products based on customer demand.
* Continuously improve existing packages based on conversion, customer feedback, and market trends.

**Supplier and Commercial Management**

* Negotiate competitive rates, payment terms, service standards, and commercial agreements.
* Build alternate supplier options to reduce dependency and operational risk.
* Improve contribution margins without compromising customer experience.

**Revenue and Profitability**

* Own category-level revenue, gross margins, conversion, and profitability.
* Monitor demand, pricing, sales performance, cancellations, refunds, and operational costs.
* Take corrective action when performance drops.
* Build plans to scale successful products and discontinue weak ones.

**Sales Enablement**

* Work closely with the sales team to improve product understanding and conversion.
* Create destination training, sales playbooks, objection-handling guides, and product comparison tools.
* Analyse sales calls and customer objections to improve products and communication.
* Ensure the sales team has the right products, pricing, and information to close effectively.

* Identify high-potential campaigns, destinations, customer segments, and seasonal opportunities.
* Share customer insights, product USPs, pricing hooks, and market intelligence with marketing teams.
* Measure whether campaigns are generating the right demand and quality of customers.

* Work with Operations and Customer Support to improve the end-to-end travel experience.

* Ensure category growth does not come at the cost of quality.

The Big Blind is a venture studio working with early-stage founders to strengthen their businesses and prepare for growth. Through FORGE, we help startups sharpen their business models, address execution gaps, improve commercial readiness and build the materials and evidence needed for meaningful investor conversations.

**The opportunity**

We are looking for someone who loves startups and can turn founder discussions into completed work. You will be the continuous point of contact for assigned founders throughout FORGE, owning programme timelines, startup readiness and growth execution with The Big Blind team and specialist mentors. This is a hands-on business-building role, not just programme administration or investment research.

FORGE combines approximately two months of business building and readiness work with investor outreach and connections from the third month. You will help founders move from diagnosis to focused action, while developing their pitch, financials and diligence readiness in parallel. Delivery must follow each startup’s agreed scope and milestones.

**What you will own**

Startup diagnosis and execution plans: Understand the product, customer, market, traction and founder priorities. Identify the most important gaps and translate them into a practical plan with owners, deadlines and evidence of completion.

Business models and growth execution: Assess each startup’s customer segments, pricing, revenue streams and unit economics. Translate strategy into go-to-market, customer acquisition and partnership experiments, track results and help founders make decisions across different business models.

Financial models and analysis: Build or improve spreadsheet models covering revenue, costs, cash flow, burn, runway and relevant unit economics. Test assumptions and scenarios, reconcile available actuals and explain the numbers clearly to founders.

Pitch and business materials: Develop and refine pitch decks, one-pagers and business narratives. Ensure the market story, growth plan and financial model are consistent, supported and easy to understand.

Continuous founder engagement: Stay actively connected with founders throughout the programme, not only during sessions. Run the twice-weekly working cadence, set pre-work, follow up between sessions, resolve bottlenecks and keep founders accountable and supported.

Diligence readiness: Organise the data room and supporting evidence, identify missing information and track closure of readiness gaps. Coordinate legal, tax or other specialist inputs where needed rather than substituting for professional advice.

Mentors and network coordination: Bring the right internal or external expertise into each startup’s work. Support approved customer, partner and investor introductions with relevant materials, clear follow-through and accurate feedback tracking.

Timeline and readiness ownership: Own milestones, dependencies and delivery dates for each startup. Track commercial and investor-readiness gaps, flag slippage early and agree recovery actions. Maintain accurate records and weekly updates through programme close and handover.

**What you should bring**

At least 2 years of relevant experience in startup operations, a founder’s office, venture building, an accelerator or incubator, consulting, or another role involving hands-on work with early-stage businesses.

A genuine interest in startups and the judgement to work constructively with founders through ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.

A practical understanding of multiple startup business models, such as SaaS, marketplaces, D2C, services and product-led businesses. Know how pricing, sales cycles, margins, working capital and growth drivers differ, and adapt the execution plan accordingly.

Confidence building and reviewing financial models in Excel or Google Sheets. You should understand how revenue, costs, cash flow, burn and runway connect, and be able to challenge assumptions without inventing missing data.

The ability to turn complex ideas and analysis into clear pitch decks, one-pagers and action plans using PowerPoint, Google Slides or similar tools.

Strong project ownership: managing multiple workstreams, following up consistently and producing high-quality deliverables on time.

Strong analytical and presentation skills: interpret financial and business data, structure recommendations clearly and present them confidently to founders and stakeholders. Communicate clearly in writing and facilitate productive discussions.

Discretion with startup information and a habit of distinguishing verified facts, founder claims and working assumptions.

**Helpful but not essential**

Ideally, an MBA, a master’s degree in finance, or relevant hands-on finance experience. A specific degree is not required; practical ability and relevant experience matter.

Experience supporting pre-seed or seed-stage startups through business building, fundraising preparation or investor diligence.

Exposure to customer discovery, sales experiments, partnership development or operating metrics across different business models.

Familiarity with cap tables, startup data rooms and investor-facing materials.

Experience coordinating mentors, specialists or cross-functional teams without relying on formal authority.

**What good performance looks like**

Founders stay engaged throughout the programme. Each startup has a current plan, clear owners and dates, with timely follow-ups and recovery actions when milestones slip.

Sessions lead to completed actions and useful evidence, not just meeting notes. Blockers and scope changes are surfaced early.

Financial models are usable and internally consistent; assumptions and gaps are transparent. Pitch materials accurately reflect the business.

Startups make measurable progress against agreed growth priorities and readiness milestones, backed by evidence rather than activity alone, and finish with usable materials and clear next steps.

Introductions and investor conversations are well prepared and followed through. Success is not defined by promising funding or guaranteeing growth.

title: SEO Lead - Mumbai (on-site)
description:
**About WebPros**
WebPros is committed to empowering businesses worldwide through cutting-edge solutions in web hosting, billing automation, infrastructure, server management, and online marketing. Since our founding in 2017, we’ve rapidly grown into a global leader, expanding our robust portfolio to include industry-defining brands such as cPanel & WHM, Plesk, WHMCS, SolusVM, XOVI, SocialBee, Sitejet and Comet Backup.
  
  
Today, we power 85 million+ websites across 900,000+ servers worldwide, backed by a 650+ strong team of dedicated professionals spanning multiple continents. At WebPros, we focus on flexibility, autonomy, and work-life balance, with remote and hybrid working options available depending on the country and role. Whether you prefer working from a bustling city hub or a quiet home office, we enable our teams to thrive while staying deeply connected through our strong collaborative culture.
  
  
**Your Role**
Hi, I’m Pedro Marzagão, Digital Marketing Director at WebPros, and your future manager. I lead the Digital Marketing team that works across WebPros brands such as cPanel, Plesk, and others, covering SEO, paid, content, and marketing operations.
  
  
This role is for an SEO Lead and owns organic growth for a set of brands. You will continue growing by working in parallel with our SEO Manager, Tejas Vernekar, who leads a different set of brands, and co-manage the relationship with our external SEO and content agencies. We want your focus on turning organic visibility, in classic search and in AI answers, into pipeline and revenue.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the SEO roadmap for your brands and execute against the existing strategy, so that organic growth stays consistent while you add ideas that evolve it.
* Prioritize SEO opportunities by expected business impact, so that effort moves from traffic to pipeline and revenue.
* Work with our external SEO and content agencies through clear briefs, reviews, and quality standards (accuracy, E-E-A-T), so that deliverables tie to business goals.
* Lead technical and on-page SEO with web development teams (crawlability, structured data, Core Web Vitals, migrations, international), so that our sites are easy to find and index.
* Grow brand visibility in AI search (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) and measure brand demand beyond clicks (branded search, share of voice, AI citations), so that we understand our real reach.
* Build your own dashboards and AI-assisted workflows with GA4, Google Search Console, and MCP integrations, so that reporting and audits are fast, accurate, and less manual. No manual spreadsheet fill-ins.
* Coordinate stakeholders across product, brand, and development teams in Jira, Slack or existing operation trackers, so that SEO work is visible, prioritized, and delivered on time.

**Your Qualifications**
**Must-haves**

* 6–8 years of hands-on SEO experience across technical, on-page, content strategy, and measurement, preferably on the brand side rather than primarily in an agency environment.
* Proven ability to independently own SEO initiatives from strategy to execution, and to turn ideas into prioritized work tied to business impact, connecting organic performance to revenue rather than traffic alone.
* Experience managing external agencies or vendors, with strong project management skills across multiple stakeholders and tools like Jira or Monday.com.
* Strong analytical skills in GA4 and Google Search Console, and hands-on experience using AI tools and MCP integrations to combine data and build your own dashboards.
* Based in Mumbai and open to working from the office 5 days/week.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Has built AI-assisted or automated workflows (agents, scripts, or pipelines) that measurably reduced manual SEO or reporting effort.
* Experience connecting organic performance to pipeline and revenue – by creating forecast models.
* Hands-on experience improving visibility in AI search (GEO/AEO), with examples of experiments and results.
* Experience across multiple brands or markets, including international SEO.
* Background in B2B SaaS, hosting, or other technical products with developer or sysadmin audiences.

**Your Impact in the First 120 Days**

* 30 days (Learn & Integrate): Complete onboarding, get to know the brands, the existing SEO strategy, and the agency partners, and meet your peer SEO Senior Manager and key stakeholders.
* 60 days (Contribute & Collaborate): Take ownership of the roadmap for your brands, run the agency check-ins, and share your first prioritization ideas based on business impact.
* 90 days (Take Ownership): Run your brands’ SEO initiatives with minimal supervision, with your own dashboards and reporting in place, and deliver your first measurable results.
* 120 days (Drive Growth): Own the role end to end, including agency performance and revenue-focused reporting, and propose your first improvements to the strategy, backed by data.

**You Might Thrive Here If You**

* Take initiative and solve problems without waiting for direction
* Enjoy turning data into decisions, and decisions into business results
* Collaborate openly across teams, agencies, and time zones
* Look for ways to use AI to work smarter, while keeping human judgment in the loop
* Care about quality and the end-user experience

**You Might Struggle Here If You**

* Prefer to execute hands-on rather than guide agencies and partners
* Measure success mainly by rankings and traffic rather than business impact
* Are uncomfortable giving and receiving feedback
* Prefer rigid structures and top-down direction
* Are not comfortable with using AI to improve workflows and reporting

**How We Work**

* Team & workflow: This role is office-based in Mumbai [5 days/week], working daily with a global team and external agencies, with remote, asynchronous collaboration.
* Collaboration & ownership: Self-managed work, with a strong emphasis on being autonomous and proactive, and good time management.

**Our Culture**
WebPros is built on
**diversity**
, not just in principle but by design. We’ve grown through acquiring industry-leading brands, bringing together teams from
**42+ nationalities, 20+ countries, and 10+ brands**
. Instead of enforcing a one-size-fits-all culture, we embrace unique perspectives, different working styles, and localized expertise to drive global innovation.
  
  
We are a
**fully remote, async-friendly**
company where transparency, open communication, and collaborative problem-solving define how we work. Whether you thrive in the fast pace of a startup or the stability of an established product, WebPros offers a dynamic, evolving career journey that you can shape based on your strengths.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable workplace where every team member feels valued, heard, and supported because our diversity is our strength.
  
  
**Compensation & Benefits**
We believe benefits go beyond just perks. At WebPros, we invest in your growth, flexibility, and well-being, so you can do your best work and build a meaningful career. While we strive to provide equal global benefits for all team members, some may vary by location, and we’ll clarify the details with you during the interview process.
  
  
**Your Hiring Experience**

* Screening Interview (30 min): An informal conversation with Radostina, your Talent Partner, designed to get to know you better. We’ll discuss your background, motivations, and career aspirations while providing a clear overview of WebPros, the team structure, and what you can expect throughout the hiring process. This is your chance to ask questions and ensure the role aligns with your professional goals.
* Hiring Manager Interview (45 min): Discussion with Pedro Marzagão to assess team fit, self-reliance, technical alignment, and problem-solving skills.
* Technical & Culture Interview (60 min) A conversation with Tejas Vernekar, our SEO Manager; this is a deeper look at your SEO expertise.

**Our Commitment to a Diverse & Inclusive Culture**
At WebPros, we want every team member to feel excited to bring their full, authentic self to work. Our strength lies in the diversity of our people, with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences driving innovation and making us stronger together.
  
  
We are committed to ensuring equitable opportunities, pay, and support for all employees, regardless of identity, background, or circumstances. We foster a culture of belonging, respect, and psychological safety, where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to contribute meaningfully and grow.
  
  
Discrimination of any kind, including sexism, racism, xenophobia, homophobia, transphobia, ableism, and ageism, has no place here. By embracing differences and championing inclusivity, we create an environment where everyone can thrive.
  
  
We are looking forward to your application!

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Thrillophilia**

Thrillophilia is one of India’s leading experiential travel platforms, helping millions of travellers discover and book curated holidays and experiences across India and international destinations.

We are building destination-led travel businesses where each category is managed with clear ownership across product, pricing, suppliers, marketing, sales, customer experience, revenue, and profitability.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Category Manager**
who can take complete ownership of a destination or travel category and build it like an independent business.

This is not a procurement-only or operations-only role.

You will be responsible for identifying market opportunities, creating differentiated products, building the right supplier ecosystem, improving pricing and margins, enabling sales, working with marketing, and driving customer satisfaction.

A strong Category Manager should be able to say:

**“This destination is my business. Revenue, margins, product quality, suppliers, conversion, customer experience, and growth are all my responsibility.”**

**What You Will Own**

**Category Strategy**

* Build the growth strategy for an assigned destination or travel category.
* Identify demand opportunities based on seasonality, customer trends, visa changes, airline connectivity, search demand, and competitor activity.
* Define the right customer segments, product mix, pricing strategy, and growth priorities.
* Create quarterly and annual plans for revenue, margins, and market share.

**Product Development**

* Build differentiated itineraries and travel products based on customer demand.
* Continuously improve existing packages based on conversion, customer feedback, and market trends.
* Create clear product USPs that make the category easier to sell and harder to replicate.
* Ensure the product portfolio serves different customer segments, budgets, and travel styles.

**Supplier and Commercial Management**

* Identify, onboard, and manage high-quality suppliers, hotels, DMCs, transport partners, and experience providers.
* Negotiate competitive rates, payment terms, service standards, and commercial agreements.
* Build alternate supplier options to reduce dependency and operational risk.
* Improve contribution margins without compromising customer experience.

**Revenue and Profitability**

* Own category-level revenue, gross margins, conversion, and profitability.
* Monitor demand, pricing, sales performance, cancellations, refunds, and operational costs.
* Take corrective action when performance drops.
* Build plans to scale successful products and discontinue weak ones.

**Sales Enablement**

* Work closely with the sales team to improve product understanding and conversion.
* Create destination training, sales playbooks, objection-handling guides, and product comparison tools.
* Analyse sales calls and customer objections to improve products and communication.
* Ensure the sales team has the right products, pricing, and information to close effectively.

**Marketing Collaboration**

* Partner with Performance Marketing, Content, SEO, CRM, and Brand teams.
* Identify high-potential campaigns, destinations, customer segments, and seasonal opportunities.
* Share customer insights, product USPs, pricing hooks, and market intelligence with marketing teams.
* Measure whether campaigns are generating the right demand and quality of customers.

**Customer Experience**

* Track customer feedback, NPS, complaints, cancellations, and service failures.
* Work with Operations and Customer Support to improve the end-to-end travel experience.
* Identify recurring issues and fix them at the product or supplier level.
* Ensure category growth does not come at the cost of quality.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in category management, business ownership, travel product management, P&L management, or a related role.
* Experience in travel, consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplaces, hospitality, or a high-growth business.
* Strong commercial understanding of revenue, margins, pricing, and profitability.
* Ability to analyse market demand and translate insights into products and business decisions.
* Strong negotiation and supplier-management skills.
* High ownership and comfort working across multiple teams.
* Ability to operate in a fast-paced, target-oriented environment.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Comfort working with data, dashboards, and performance metrics.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience owning a destination, category, geography, or business line.
* Experience in outbound or domestic holiday packages.
* Exposure to sales-led or high-consideration customer journeys.
* Experience managing both product and commercial outcomes.
* MBA or equivalent business education is an advantage, but not mandatory.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Category revenue
* Contribution margin and profitability
* Booking conversion
* Product performance
* Supplier competitiveness
* Customer satisfaction and NPS
* Cancellation and refund rates
* Sales productivity
* New product success
* Market share growth

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first 6 months, you should be able to:

* Build a clear understanding of the assigned destination or category.
* Identify the biggest gaps in product, pricing, suppliers, and conversion.
* Create a structured category growth plan.
* Improve product quality, supplier competitiveness, and sales readiness.
* Establish clear performance dashboards and operating reviews.

Over time, you should build and scale the category into a significant, profitable business with strong customer trust and clear market differentiation.

**Why Join Thrillophilia?**

* Own a business, not just a function.
* Work directly on revenue, margins, products, suppliers, sales, and customer experience.
* Build destinations and categories at meaningful scale.
* Work closely with senior leaders across business, marketing, sales, product, and operations.
* Get the opportunity to grow into a Category Head, Business Head, or P&L leader.

We are looking for someone who thinks like a founder, acts like an operator, and takes complete responsibility for outcomes.

title: Strategy & Ops - Growth, Retention & Engagement
description:
**About the job**

About BharatNXTEvery day, 64 million Indian micro and small businesses build with grit and audacity, and BharatNXT is building the financial infrastructure to fuel that ambition. We help businesses turn existing credit tools like cards into flexible working capital, while enabling them to pay vendors, GST and invoices and manage cards, limits and payouts all on one platform.

Today, BharatNXT serves 2M+ users across 450+ cities, powered by an in-house financial infrastructure with 100+ risk checks, fraud below 0.02%, and a dynamic pricing engine evaluating 20+ parameters across 10,000+ daily transactions. But payments are just the starting point - we’re building India’s MSME Financial Operating System, spanning Run, Manage and Grow, with embedded credit, insurance and personalised financial products powered by signals from every transaction, interaction and GST filing.

Our Predictive Journey Engine interprets 100+ data points per user to continuously personalise pricing, limits, products, reminders and rewards. We’re building towards powering the next 10 million entrepreneurs and rebuilding Bharat’s operational and credit rails from the ground up.

**The Role**

Own our engagement stack end-to-end, powering 15000+ customer touchpoints across multiple products and high-frequency user journeys. Today, it powers campaigns, journeys, cohorts and app personalization across multiple user touchpoints. You will own the platform, the data flowing into it, what gets built on top of it, and the performance of the engagement engine.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You won't be handed a campaign calendar and asked to execute it. You'll identify opportunities, decide what needs to be built, test it, measure it, and kill or scale it based on results.

**What you'll do**

* Own Martech stack end to end - events, user properties, segments, integrations, hygiene and documentation. Data flows in from CRM, our AI calling stack, MMP, Other external platforms and app events; you make sure it's accurate and usable.
* Strategically define and build cohorts using user data, behavioural signals and footprints across platforms.
* Review and rebuild what's live - map every flow and cohort, fix what's broken, retire what isn't working, and put a review cadence on the rest.
* Run campaigns across channels - WhatsApp, RCS, email, push, in-app banners and GIFs, app tiles, website and banners.
* Test relentlessly - structured A/B tests on creative, timing, channel and journey design, with a test log so learnings compound.
* Build cohorts and app personalization - identify new behavioural and transactional cohorts and build cross-sell, upsell, retention and reactivation journeys around them.
* Fix the funnel - use UXCam / Clarity and product data to identify where users struggle, translate those insights into actionable cohorts or interventions, and drive product/UX/engineering fixes to closure.
* Design, Rollout, Monitor and Correct within 48 hours - build dashboards and alerts to catch funnel drops, delivery failures, data issues and integration breaks before they become business problems.
* Partner cross-functionally - work closely with Growth, Product, Business, Data, Design and Engineering to turn user insights into measurable growth initiatives.

What we're looking for

* 2–5 years of hands-on lifecycle marketing, CRM or growth execution in an app-first business.
* You have personally built journeys and campaigns in MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze or WebEngage - not just briefed an agency.
* Practical experience running push, WhatsApp, email and in-app at scale, including deliverability and fatigue management.
* Strong funnel and cohort analysis. You can pull and sanity-check your own data (SQL or BI is a plus).
* Comfortable working with Tech on event tracking, integrations and data requirements.
* Strong attention to detail. Small errors in cohort logic, event tracking or journey conditions can have a large impact.
* You create structure in ambiguity instead of waiting for someone else to create it.
* Familiarity with AI and agentic tools like Claude and Gemini.
* You are comfortable challenging existing processes and asking, "Why are we doing this?" when the data doesn't support it.
* Brownie points if your family comes from a business background and/or you have a degree in analytics or Chartered accountancy.

**Why take it**

* You’ll own an engagement stack that touches every stage of the user lifecycle, in a business where retention and product adoption directly impact revenue.
* There’s a lot to build, iterate and experiment with. That’s exactly what gives you the headroom to stand out, take ownership and make a meaningful mark.
* If you’re looking for a role where nobody counts the hours - we measure the impact you create, this is it.

Who should not take it up

* You’re not deeply driven to build the next large consumer business for India’s micro & small businesses, and would rather optimise for comfort than impact.
* You care more about perks and flexibility than the opportunity to build something meaningful and shape it from the ground up.
* You’re looking for a siloed, low-collaboration role. We work closely across Business, Marketing, Product, Tech and other teams - co-designing, challenging and building together is a big part of the job.
* You prefer clearly defined boundaries over taking ownership, figuring things out and getting things done in an evolving environment.

We are a small team of highly motivated people and want people who have a strong sense of ownership and passion for what they do. If you are expecting a 9-5 types, very well defined structured role - this is not the place for you. But if you are looking for a steep learning curve building innovation in the payment space and are ready to roll up your sleeves to get work done, we would love to hear from you!

title: Publicity Manager - India
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
  
  
**Can you turn a great story into a cultural conversation?**
When you watch an Indian blockbuster cross over to global audiences, do you find yourself dissecting how it got there — which story landed, which journalist broke it first, which moment made it cultural? When a campaign wraps, do you reflect on what you'd do differently? Do you read entertainment news not just as a fan but as a student of how stories travel? If so, we may have just the opportunity for you to join the Originals publicity team.
  
  
**The Role**
Netflix is looking for a Publicity Manager to lead South title campaigns — Tamil, Telugu, and beyond. You will also end up working on a mix of other local and global titles. You'll own earned media strategy and execution for a slate of originals, working closely with filmmakers, talent, and a cross-functional team across content, marketing, and communications.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. You'll write the strategy and book the travel. You'll pitch a cover story and manage a talent handler on set. You will guide a team member and be willing to roll up your sleeves to do the work.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and execute publicity campaigns for South originals from production through launch and beyond — announcements, junkets, press moments, and post-launch coverage
* Work with partners to develop media strategy across broadcast, print, digital, and social — with a sharp instinct for what makes a story travel regionally and nationally
* Serve as the primary point of contact for filmmakers, talent, and production partners throughout the campaign lifecycle
* Pitch and secure media opportunities; cultivate journalists, critics, and influencers
* Integrate with marketing, social, content, awards, and festival teams to build campaigns that are greater than the sum of their parts
* Manage agencies, vendors, and budgets; give leadership clear visibility into process and priorities
* Stay ahead of shifts in the entertainment and cultural landscape — what audiences care about, what media is chasing, what's breaking next

**What We're Looking For**

* Campaign thinker, not just executor. You have a point of view on how a campaign should be built — and you can articulate what you're trying to do and why. You think about earned media not in press releases but through narratives.
* Deep regional expertise. You understand South Indian cinema, television, and the cultural currents that shape them. You know what makes a Tamil film travel differently from a Telugu one, and you know the media landscape intimately — who covers what, and why.
* Exceptional media relationships. You have strong existing relationships with key journalists, editors, and influencers across key markets in the South, and a track record of securing meaningful coverage — not just volume, but the right story in the right outlet at the right moment.
* You consume entertainment and culture voraciously — not just as a consumer but as an analyst. You notice what's breaking through and why.
* Integrated mindset. You think across channels — earned, social, talent, experiential — and can connect the dots between a press strategy, a talent moment, and a marketing beat.
* Strong communicator. Clear, direct, and effective with everyone from a journalist to a filmmaker to a Netflix executive. Fluent in English, Hindi, and can speak Tamil and/or Telugu. Candidates who have worked in the Tamil or Telugu entertainment industry are especially encouraged to apply.

**Qualifications**

* 9-10 years of entertainment publicity experience — studio, OTT, network, agency, or journalism
* Demonstrated experience running end-to-end campaigns for South Indian titles or talent
* Comfort managing agencies, budgets, and cross-functional partners

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**About Innvikta**

Innvikta builds cybersecurity awareness products that help organizations engage employees and strengthen their security culture. Innvikta Arcade, our gamified security awareness platform, includes scenario-based games, team challenges, live quizzes, and leaderboards that bring security awareness into everyday work.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a Marketing Manager to grow Innvikta’s visibility in the cybersecurity industry and establish it as a credible global cybersecurity product company. You’ll own how Innvikta positions itself, how enterprise buyers discover us, and what they see when they evaluate our products.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can set the strategy, write a strong campaign brief, develop a customer story, and get a campaign out the door. You’ll work closely with leadership, product, and sales to reach CISOs, security awareness leaders, IT and risk teams, and channel partners. Paid campaigns can amplify your work, and we expect you to build channels that generate visibility and demand organically.

**What you’ll own**

* **Brand positioning and messaging.**
  Define how Innvikta stands out in cybersecurity awareness and human risk management. Develop messaging by buyer and market, and carry it consistently across the website, pitch decks, demos, product videos, and partner materials.
* **Product marketing and launches.**
  Translate features into outcomes that matter to enterprise buyers. Lead go-to-market campaigns for new capabilities and use cases, and equip sales with product briefs, buyer guides, competitive comparisons, and demo narratives.
* **Organic growth and industry visibility.**
  Build an audience through LinkedIn, search, webinars, newsletters, and cybersecurity communities. Develop original campaign ideas, such as live experiences that let security leaders try Innvikta Arcade firsthand.
* **PR and thought leadership.**
  Build relationships with cybersecurity publications, event organizers, and industry communities. Pitch contributed articles, secure speaking opportunities, and help Innvikta’s leadership develop a recognizable point of view on security awareness.
* **Customer proof and enterprise credibility.**
  Turn customer implementations into case studies, testimonials, and reference stories. Work with product and security teams to present verified outcomes, product capabilities, and security or compliance information clearly and accurately.
* **Partner marketing.**
  Build campaigns and co-branded materials with distributors, resellers, and cybersecurity partners. Help them explain where Innvikta fits, who it serves, and how to sell it.
* **Measurement.**
  Track reach among target accounts, earned coverage, qualified demo requests, and marketing-sourced or influenced pipeline. Use the results to decide where to invest next.

**What you’ll bring**

* Experience owning B2B marketing programs for a cybersecurity, enterprise SaaS, or IT product company. Direct experience marketing to security leaders is preferred.
* A portfolio of campaigns that earned attention or generated demand through organic content, PR, partnerships, events, or communities.
* Strong product positioning, competitive research, and writing skills. You can explain a technical product to a CISO and make its business case clear to other decision-makers.
* Experience creating enterprise sales materials and customer case studies, with the judgment to substantiate claims before publishing them.
* The ability to set a high creative standard, brief designers and agencies, and keep the brand consistent across channels.
* Comfort using CRM and analytics tools to connect campaign activity with qualified opportunities and pipeline.
* The ability to work independently and collaborate with product, sales, customers, and partners to ship work.

**Good to have**

* Familiarity with security awareness, phishing simulations, human risk management, or how enterprise security teams evaluate vendors.
* Experience launching a B2B technology product in multiple markets or building a partner marketing program.
* Existing relationships with cybersecurity media, industry associations, event organizers, or channel partners.

**What success looks like**

In your first 90 days, you’ll sharpen Innvikta’s positioning, bring its core website and sales materials into line with that positioning, and launch an organic campaign for a defined enterprise audience. Over time, success means more visibility in the cybersecurity industry, stronger customer proof, and a measurable contribution to qualified demo requests and pipeline.
